tokens.name: brand-night
tokens.usage: Fixed. The Night ground of marketing heroes, the card band and the dark side of the dusk fade. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Fixed. Deep patina: virtual card base, the Rising column on light grounds, large brand blocks.

tokens.name: brand-verdigris
tokens.usage: Fixed. Verdigris: the brand green on light grounds. Same value as accent in Day.

tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Fixed. Soft patina: the light on Night grounds. Globe arcs, primary buttons, the italic word and the Rising column on Night only. Never on light grounds (fails contrast).

tokens.name: brand-bronze
tokens.usage: Fixed. Bronze: decorative highlight, one per screen at most. For text use held.

tokens.name: brand-limestone
tokens.usage: Fixed. Limestone: the light side of the dusk fade and light brand blocks.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground of the app and of Day marketing sections.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised: panels, sheets, payment lists, form fields.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken: specimen tablets, table headers, selected rows.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The opposite ground, for one inverted block per page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, eyebrows on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (4.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: secondary buttons, inputs, rail chips (3:1 on surface-100 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active nav, selected states. Verdigris by day, soft patina by night.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind selected rows and the italic-word highlight in marketing.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 3px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: settled
tokens.usage: Settled status text and dot, on settled-bg.

tokens.name: settled-bg
tokens.usage: Settled pill fill.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending status text and dot, on pending-bg.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Pending pill fill.

tokens.name: held
tokens.usage: Held status (money reserved, not spent): text and dot on held-bg. The bronze of the UI.

tokens.name: held-bg
tokens.usage: Held pill fill.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Failed status, errors and destructive actions, on failed-bg or surface-100.

tokens.name: failed-bg
tokens.usage: Failed pill fill and error field backgrounds.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: wordmark

styles.name: display-xl

styles.name: display-l

styles.usage: Night band callouts and section openers on marketing pages.

styles.name: heading-2

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Panel and card titles, flow step names.

styles.name: amount-xl

styles.name: body-l

styles.name: body

styles.name: body-strong

styles.name: body-s

styles.name: label

styles.name: data

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Rail chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The virtual card (credit-card proportion 1.586:1).

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The virtual card only. Panels use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glow

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; the hero and bands bleed full width behind it.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length of running text.

tokens.name: touch-min
